description: This PHP source file implements a Data Access Object (DAO) class called 'MembershipDao' for managing 'Membership' entities within the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for creating, retrieving, listing, counting, and deleting membership records, as well as checking for the existence of a membership name.

classes.name: MembershipDao
classes.description: A data access class responsible for CRUD operations and queries related to 'Membership' entities in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveMembership
methods.description: Persists a 'Membership' entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves a 'Membership' entity by its ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingMembershipIds
methods.description: Returns a list of existing membership IDs from a provided list of IDs.

methods.name: getMembershipByName
methods.description: Retrieves a 'Membership' entity by its name, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: getMembershipList
methods.description: Fetches a list of memberships based on search filter parameters, using pagination.

methods.name: getMembershipListPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for listing memberships based on search filters.

methods.name: getMembershipCount
methods.description: Counts the number of memberships matching the search filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteMemberships
methods.description: Deletes memberships by a list of IDs and returns the number of records affected.

methods.name: isExistingMembershipName
methods.description: Checks if a membership name already exists in the system.
